newsitem.title: USA: Dow drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average fell more than 50 points on Monday as a weak bond market prompted renewed selling after Friday's 157-point plunge.

Shortly after 2 p.m. EDT(/1800 GMT), the Dow was off 51.57 points to 7,979.65, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond fell more than half a point, boosting its yield to 6.68 percent.
